template.subject: {competitionName}: {subject}
template.email:
Hello {recipientName},

There is news about {competitionName}.

{body}

Friends of Animals
template.sms: Friends of Animals: news about {competitionName}, "{subject}". For details, visit friendsofanimals.dev/contact.

meta.title: Announcements
meta.description: Write, preview and send announcements to a competition's confirmed registrants.

adminAnnouncements.title: Announcements
adminAnnouncements.lead: Tell a competition's confirmed registrants what they need to know. Messages about a child go to their guardian.

denied.title: This page is for competition managers
denied.body: Your account can't manage this competition's announcements. A super admin can give you the competition manager role.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that
notFound.body: The competition or announcement doesn't exist, or it was removed.

index.sentOn: Sent {date} to {count, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# person} other {# people}}

form.lead: Plain text only. Leave out any section you don't need. Each one you fill in becomes a heading and its text in the message.
form.subject: Subject
form.subjectHint: Up to 150 characters. It starts the email's subject line.
form.eventAt: Date and time of the event (IST)
form.eventAtHint: Leave it empty if there isn't one.
form.helpContactsHint: Who to write to or call with a question.

errors.subject: Write a subject of up to 150 characters.
errors.eventAt: Enter a real date and time, or leave it empty.
errors.sections: Fill in at least one section besides the subject.
errors.field: This is too long, or holds a character we can't send.

detail.title: Announcement
detail.created: The draft is ready. Preview it below before sending.
detail.sentDone: The announcement is on its way to {count, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# person} other {# people}}.
detail.sentSummary: Sent {date} to {count, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# person} other {# people}}. A sent announcement can't be changed: write a new one to correct it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.lead: This preview shows the saved draft as it would appear to a sample recipient.
preview.counts: It will go to {recipients, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# person} other {# people}}: {participants, plural, one {# participant} other {# participants}}, {guardians, plural, one {# guardian} other {# guardians}} and {coordinators, plural, one {# coordinator} other {# coordinators}}.
preview.unreachable: {count, plural, one {# participant has} other {# participants have}} no one we can reach, and won't hear about it.

send.title: Send announcement?
send.lead: Sending tells everyone above by email, by SMS when it's switched on, and in their inbox if they have an account. It can't be undone.
send.confirm: Send this announcement to {count, plural, =0 {nobody} one {# person} other {# people}}?
send.unconfirmed: Confirm the send from the preview.

refusals.forbidden: Your account can't manage this competition's announcements.
refusals.not_found: That announcement doesn't exist any more.
refusals.invalid_input: Something in the form isn't right. Check it and try again.
refusals.announcement_already_sent: This announcement has already been sent.
refusals.announcement_draft_changed: This draft changed after you opened the preview. Review the updated preview and confirm the send again.
refusals.announcement_not_editable: A sent announcement can't be changed.
